title: Beneath Brymassen

supportedRulesets.progressionRecommendation: 3-6 beginning player characters; DMOS treats the source as level-1 introductory play.

playerMetadata.pitch: Raiders have breached the cellars beneath Brymassen. Take a straightforward bounty to clear them out, or race underground to recover four kidnapped children before their captors decide what to do with them.
playerMetadata.setting: Brymassen and the dungeon beneath its buildings

hard.rule: The campaign has separate crawl and rescue modes, and Room 14 must use exactly one matching source variant.
Room 7 has no secret door; its apparent clues are deliberate false leads.
The Room 11 grizzled hobgoblin is non-hostile unless attacked and operates as an information broker.
Room 8 kobolds are hiding from their own chieftain after stealing part of the tribal treasure.
In rescue mode, the Room 12 orcs are the slavers/buyers the Room 14 kobolds are considering selling the children to.
Room 5's eastern natural passage leads to a concealed outside exit.

conditional.rule: Room 13 skeleton guardians activate only if attacked or the sarcophagus is touched.
Room 4 centipedes may emerge when the sludge/debris is disturbed; merely crossing the room is safe.

soft.rule: Minor Brymassen residents/services may be improvised if they do not alter the chosen hook or dungeon truth.

freeImprovisation.rule: Dialogue, mundane travel detail and tactical choices may be improvised while preserving room topology, actor motives and mode-specific truth.

scenes.title: Trouble Beneath Brymassen
requiredFacts: The source supports two different hooks and two different Room 14 variants.

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Establish one campaign mode before Room 14 is instantiated; never merge variants.

scenes.title: The Dungeon Beneath Brymassen
requiredFacts: Rooms, traps, neutral actors and alternate exit obey source topology and triggers.
hiddenFacts: Room 7's fake door is genuinely false
Room 11 broker is neutral until attacked

choices.label: Backtrack or leave through a known exit

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Resolve any reasonable action through native rules while preserving map, trigger and faction state.

scenes.title: The Captive Children
requiredFacts: Four children remain captive until physically freed
Kobolds may ransom or sell them
Room 12 orcs are the prospective slavers

choices.label: Use stealth/distraction to lower the cage

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Support creative rescue tactics without teleporting the children free or changing who holds them.

scenes.title: The Fallen Bird Cage
requiredFacts: This version contains stirges and a crushed goblin, not kidnapped children or a chieftain.

choices.label: Search after the threat is controlled

endings.title: Children Returned
endings.summary: The four children are returned alive and the family reward resolves according to the agreed rescue hook.

endings.title: Bounty Claimed
endings.summary: The party returns under the crawl-mode contract and receives payment only for proof covered by the mayor's terms.

endings.title: The Dungeon Remains
endings.summary: The party withdraws before resolving its objective; all discovered routes, actor outcomes and hazards persist for a later return.

communityIntelligence.finding: Beginning characters may retreat/re-enter, attack the information broker despite attempted parley, and focus strongly on bounty/loot incentives.
Used successfully as an introductory Basic Fantasy adventure and as a springboard into a continuing campaign.

adaptationNotes: Keep crawl/rescue modes distinct through a runtime discriminator.
Persist trap, route, negotiation and creature state after retreat.
Never create a secret door in Room 7.
Production distribution requires complete OGL/Copyright Notice packaging and must exclude source artwork unless separately licensed.
